newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo exchange halts trading in Asia Capital.
newsitem.headline: Colombo exchange halts trading in Asia Capital.

text.p: Trading in shares of investment bank Asia Capital was temporarily halted on Thursday and will recommence on Friday, said a Colombo Stock Exchange official.

"The temporary halt of one day is only until information about a special provision for diminution in the value of an investment which reflects on company profits, is disseminated," said the official who declined to be identified.

Asia Capital said in a statement on Thursday that it had made a specific provision of 148.5 million rupees for the diminution in value of the investment made in Dimo Auto Industries, which makes bus bodies.

The consolidated profit and loss account for the year ended March 31, 1997 of Asia Capital would reflect this provision by turning a net profit after tax (unaudited) of 41.1 million into a loss of 107.3 million, the company statement said.
